text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer! A soaring,
sweeping—absolute
victory!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Well, it's only natural. I'm the
world's
strongest, after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Well, it's only natural. I'm the
world's
strongest, after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm countin' on you for the training I
need to stay
on top!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That said, my next victory is already a
sure thing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know! That's just what my papa always
says!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The real fear comes after you win.
That's when
there's a target on your
back!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can't get complacent with more strong
enemies
ahead! Don't worry, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep on headin' toward the very
top!
